column2: Heaven is singular in the opening address, followed by earth hearing the words; the two poetic clauses receive separate display lines.
The utterance is awaited like rain and descends like dew, with shower and snow similes retained rather than substituting familiar alternate imagery.
The speaker has called the Lord's name and commands the hearers to ascribe greatness to our God.
True works, judgments, faithfulness, absence of unrighteousness, righteousness and holiness remain in the selected sequence; Rock is not inserted.
The inherited wording takes not His with blemished children, and retains the crooked/perverse generation parallel.
column3: Ouk auto can instead be connected with sinned, yielding not against Him. The attachment and force of the negative remain unresolved; not His is a provisional syntactic choice, not a settled token alignment.

column2: Foolish and unwise remain paired; Father, acquired, made and created all stay, without replacing acquisition with begetting.
Days of old and generations are recalled through asking father and elders, with both reporting verbs retained.
The selected angels of God governs the national boundaries; sons of Adam remains in the preceding scattering clause.
Jacob is the Lord's people and portion, and Israel His measured inheritance, retaining both names and the allocation image.
Sustaining, surrounding, teaching and guarding occur in thirsty, burning, waterless wilderness; pupil of an eye preserves the concrete image.
The eagle shelters and yearns over its young, receives them on spread wings and takes them on its back, not a substituted nest-stirring account.
The Lord alone leads the plural them with no foreign god present, retaining the change from earlier singular Jacob.
Strength of the earth is kept as the selected expression, followed by field produce, honey from rock and oil from solid rock.
column3: The idiomatic force of strength of the earth needs fuller lexical review; it is not silently replaced by a geographic height.

column2: Cattle butter, sheep milk, lambs, rams, young bulls, goats and wheat kernels remain; no Bashan name is imported into the selected young-bulls phrase.
column3: Kernels renders the wheat-kidneys metaphor contextually; the image and the dairy sense of boutyron remain items for lexical review.

column2: Jacob and the beloved one remain named descriptions, with the three repeated fat/thick/broad verbs and both divine maker and saviour titles.
The voice shifts to Me in both clauses; foreign gods is the contextual referent of the substantival adjective.
Demons are contrasted with God, and unfamiliar new gods with the fathers' knowledge; both not-know statements remain.
God begat the addressee and nourishes him; the selected begetting and nourishing are not replaced with Rock imagery.
The Lord's jealousy and provocation relate to the anger of His sons and daughters, preserving the difficult selected causal phrase.
The Lord will show what will happen at the end, not merely see it; faithlessness characterizes the sons of the perverse generation.
No god/no nation and idols/uncomprehending nation remain the paired provocations, with repeated divine first-person agency.
Wrath's fire reaches Hades below, earth and produce, and mountain foundations, preserving the full extent of the image.
Gathered evils and spent arrows remain distinct actions against the people.
Hunger, consumption by birds, backward-bending spasms, beast teeth and crawling creatures' fury preserve the selected images and afflictions.
column3: Opisthotonos is described by its bodily posture; no specific modern disease is diagnosed.

column2: Sword outside and terror from inner chambers reach young man, maiden, nursing child and aged elder in the stated pairs.
Scattering and ending remembrance among humans retain the two announced actions.
Enemy wrath, their prolonged endurance, joint attack and their boast that the Lord did not act all remain, without substituting another tradition's simpler wording.
column3: The referent of they in lest they endure long and the connection of the initial exception to the preceding threat require further syntactic review.

column2: The nation has lost counsel and lacks knowledge; the verse does not independently identify a different nation.
Past failure to understand is followed by an imperative to receive for the coming time, preserving the selected temporal movement.
One pursues a thousand and two move myriads, rendered tens of thousands; divine selling and delivery explain the disproportion.
Their gods are plural and our God singular; the enemies are without understanding, not made judges by harmonization.
Sodom's vine and Gomorrah's tendril bear grapes of gall and clusters of bitterness, retaining each parallel image.
Wine is venom of serpents and incurable venom of asps; the repeated venom renders the contextual sense of thymos.
The rhetorical question retains behold, gathering with God and sealing in His treasuries.
Repayment in vengeance, slipping foot and near destruction lead to things ready for you, preserving the selected change from their to you.
Judgment of the people and being moved concerning servants are followed by weakened, failing under assault and exhausted descriptions.
column3: Paraklethesetai can suggest comfort or a changed compassionate disposition here; be moved is a deliberately broad provisional rendering needing lexical resolution.

column2: The Lord explicitly speaks the question about their gods and their former trust, before the second-person challenge in 32:38.
You ate and you drank are second person in the selected text; the gods are then summoned as helpers and protectors.
See is repeated, divine exclusivity remains, and killing/making alive and striking/healing lead to no deliverer from My hands.
The raised hand, oath by the right hand and declaration of everlasting life all remain.
The sword is sharpened like lightning and the hand takes judgment, with repayment repeated for enemies and haters.
Arrows drink blood and sword eats flesh, with slain, captives and the head of enemy rulers all named.
The full selected stanza includes heavens, sons of God, nations, angels of God, blood of sons and cleansing the people's land; no shorter parallel text replaces it.
column3: Give Him strength for enischysatosan auto and the implied Him after those who hate are interpretive choices. The dative's exact force and supplied object remain open for specialist review.

column2: Writing and teaching the song are repeated before Moses and Joshua speak the words of this law; neither repetition nor law is harmonized away.
Moses' completed address to all Israel introduces the concluding instruction.
The people attend in heart and command their sons to keep and do all the law's words, preserving intergenerational agency.
The word is not empty but their life, and through it their days are prolonged in the land beyond Jordan.
The Lord speaks on this day, preserving the immediate setting for the death command.
Abarim, Nebo, Moab, Jericho and Canaan are retained in their geographic relations; the land is given to Israel for possession.
Moses is to die and join his people as Aaron did on Hor, preserving both comparison and gathering formula.
Plural you refers to Moses and Aaron's disobedience and failure to sanctify God at the dispute water in Kadesh, wilderness of Zin.
The selected short ending promises sight from opposite the land but prohibits entry, without importing a longer ending.
Moses is the man of God, blessing Israel before death, introducing the tribal poetry.
Sinai, Seir, Paran and myriads of Kadesh remain, with angels at His right hand; no fiery-law phrase is substituted.
The source shifts from His people to your hands/you and back to His words; the inherited singular people subject is supplied for the final received.
column3: The second-person addressee and the subject of received are not explicit. Thy/Thee selects divine address provisionally; Moses as addressee and other subject attachments require review rather than being decided by capitalization.

column2: The law commanded by Moses is an inheritance for plural assemblies of Jacob and completes the preceding received clause.
A future ruler in the beloved is linked to assembled rulers and tribes; the wording is not changed to a past-tense king.
Reuben is to live, not die and be many in number, preserving the positive selected numerical blessing.
Judah's voice, plural let them enter, his contending hands and divine help against enemies remain; direct prayer uses Thou.
column3: The antecedent of the plural entering verb remains uncertain and is not replaced with a singular imperative bring him.

column2: The plural give and third-person his manifestations/truth remain; they tested and reviled the holy man are not converted into divine second-person actions.
column3: The technical sense of delous and the distribution of manifestations and truth between Levi and the holy man require further lexical and ritual review.

column2: Not seeing parents, not acknowledging brothers and disowning sons precede keeping the divine oracles and covenant; the shifts of address remain.
Teaching Jacob and Israel is followed by incense in Thy wrath continually upon the altar, preserving the selected text without an added whole-burnt-offering clause.
Blessing strength and accepting handiwork lead to breaking the enemies' loin and preventing the haters' rising, with the singular loin retained.
The beloved of the Lord dwells confidently and God overshadows him, followed by rest between his shoulders.
column3: The subject of rested and the possessor of shoulders are not explicitly resolved by the Greek; inherited capitalized He is a provisional divine-subject interpretation.

column2: Heaven's seasons and dew and the deep springs below form the first part of Joseph's land blessing.
The sun's turnings and the conjunctions of months retain the selected seasonal and lunar descriptions.
column3: The precise agricultural force of synodoi menon is open; conjunctions is a close working rendering, not a claimed astronomical annotation.

column2: The summit of ancient mountains parallels the summit of everlasting hills, preserving the repeated summit.
Seasonal fullness and things acceptable to the One seen in the bush come upon Joseph's head and crown in the inherited rendering.
column3: The Greek nominative doxastheis after the crown phrase is syntactically difficult; the English of him who was glorified supplies a smooth relation that remains provisional.

column2: Firstborn bull, one-horned animal, nations to earth's end, Ephraim's myriads and Manasseh's thousands all remain without assigning an unverified animal species.
Zebulun's your going forth contrasts with Issachar's his dwellings, preserving the selected person change.
Destruction of nations, calling there and a sacrifice of righteousness precede sea wealth and coastal commerce.
column3: God is a contextual supplied object of call upon, not an explicit source noun; the verse's shifts between they, plural you and singular you need later full alignment.

column2: The enlarger of Gad is blessed; Gad rests as a lion after crushing an arm and a ruler, not a crown-of-head phrase from another tradition.
The first portion and rulers' apportioned land precede the Lord explicitly acting in righteousness and judgment with Israel.
Dan is a lion's cub leaping from Bashan, preserving both animal stage and location.
Naphtali's acceptable things and fullness of blessing lead to inheriting sea and south, retaining the selected directions.
Asher is blessed with children and acceptable to brothers, and dips his foot in oil.
column3: Apo teknon may support from or among children rather than the inherited with children; the relation remains an explicit open lexical-syntactic choice.

column2: The selected sandal, iron and bronze precede the second-person days/strength parallel; footwear is not replaced by bars or bolts.
The God of the beloved rides heaven as helper and is majestic in relation to the firmament, retaining the selected title and cosmic imagery.
Shelter of the God of old and strength of everlasting arms precede expelling the enemy with the wish May you perish.
column3: You are is grammatical support in the elliptical arms clause; the exact linkage of the two shelter phrases remains provisional.

column2: Israel dwells alone in confidence on Jacob's land with grain, wine and a heaven clouded with dew.
Israel's blessedness, salvation, helper's shielding and sword-boast precede enemies lying and the trampling of their neck, not substituted high places.
Moses ascends from Araboth Moab to Nebo and Pisgah opposite Jericho; the first vista is Gilead to Dan.
Naphtali, Ephraim and Manasseh, and Judah to the farthest sea retain the repeated all the land phrases.
Wilderness and the region of Jericho, city of palms, extend to Zoar in the selected vista.
The oath names Abraham, Isaac and Jacob and their seed; Moses sees but does not enter.
Moses is the Lord's household servant, dying in Moab by the Lord's word, preserving the selected designation.
They buried him is plural with no named buriers; Gai, Moab and the house of Peor remain, and nobody knows the burial place to this day.
The age is 120, with undimmed eyes and unwasted cheeks rather than a substituted general-vigour phrase.
column3: Chelynia as cheeks is a provisional anatomical rendering requiring lexical confirmation; no modern medical claim is made.

column2: Thirty days of weeping occur at Araboth Moab by Jordan opposite Jericho, followed by completion of the mourning days.
Joshua receives a spirit of understanding because Moses laid hands on him, and Israel hears him and obeys the Lord's command to Moses.
The Lord knew Moses face to face; the agency of knowing is not reversed in the statement of his unmatched prophetic role.
Signs and wonders in Egypt concern Pharaoh, his servants and all his land, keeping the threefold scope.
Great wonders and mighty hand describe what Moses did before all Israel, closing the book without an added evaluation.
